an10.99:1.1: athakho āyasmā upāli yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā upāli bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an10.99:1.2: icchāmahaṃ bhante araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevitunti.
an10.99:2.1: durabhisambhavāni hi kho upāli araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni
an10.99:2.3: ekatte haranti maññe mano vanāni samādhiṃ alabhamānassa bhikkhuno
an10.99:2.5: ahaṃ samādhiṃ alabhamāno araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevissāmīti tassetaṃ pāṭikaṃkhaṃ
an10.99:3.2: atha āgaccheyya hatthināgo sattaratano vā aḍḍhaṭṭharatano vā
an10.99:3.4: yannūnāhaṃ imaṃ udakarahadaṃ ogāhetvā kaṇṇasandhovikaṃpi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷeyyaṃ piṭṭhisandhovikaṃpi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷeyyaṃ
an10.99:3.5: kaṇṇasandhovikaṃpi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷitvā piṭṭhisandhovikaṃpi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷitvā nhātvā ca pīvitvā ca paccuttaritvā yena kāmaṃ pakkameyyanti
an10.99:3.6: so taṃ udakarahadaṃ ogāhetvā kaṇṇasandhovikaṃpi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷeyya piṭṭhisandhovikaṃpi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷeyya
an10.99:3.7: kaṇṇasandhovikaṃpi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷitvā piṭṭhisandhovikaṃpi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷitvā nhātvā ca pīvitvā ca paccuttaritvā yena kāmaṃ pakkameyya
an10.99:3.9: mahā upāli attabhāvo gambhīre gādhaṃ vindati
an10.99:4.1: atha āgaccheyya saso vā biḷāro vā
an10.99:4.4: yannūnāhaṃ imaṃ udakarahadaṃ ogāhetvā kaṇṇasandhovikaṃpi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷeyyaṃ piṭṭhisandhovikaṃpi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷeyyaṃ
an10.99:4.5: kaṇṇasandhovikaṃpi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷitvā piṭṭhisandhovikaṃpi khiḍḍaṃ kiḷitvā nhātvā ca pīvitvā ca paccuttaritvā yena kāmaṃ pakkameyyanti
an10.99:4.10: paritto upāli attabhāvo gambhīre gādhaṃ na vindati
an10.99:4.11: evameva kho upāli yo evaṃ vadeyya
an10.99:4.12: ahaṃ samādhiṃ alabhamāno araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevissāmīti tassetaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ
an10.99:5.1: seyyathāpi upāli daharo kumāro mando uttānaseyyako sakena muttakarīsena kiḷati
an10.99:6.1: sakho so upāli kumāro aparena samayena vuddhimanvāya indriyānaṃ paripākamanvāya
an10.99:6.2: yāni tāni kumārakānaṃ kiḷāpanakāni bhavanti seyyathīdaṃ vaṅkakaṃ ghaṭikaṃ mokkhacikaṃ piṅgulikaṃ pattāḷhakaṃ rathakaṃ dhanukaṃ tehi kiḷati
an10.99:6.4: nanvāyaṃ khiḍḍā purimāya khiḍḍāya abhikkantatarā ca paṇītatarā cāti.
an10.99:7.1: sakho so upāli kumāro aparena samayena vuddhimanvāya indriyānaṃ paripākamanvāya
an10.99:7.3: cakkhuviññeyyehi rūpehi iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piyarūpehi kāmūpasañhitehi rajanīyehi
an10.99:7.7: kāyaviññeyyehi phoṭṭhabbehi iṭṭhehi kantehi manāpehi piyarūpehi kāmūpasañhitehi rajanīyehi
an10.99:7.9: nanvāyaṃ khiḍḍā purimāhi khiḍḍāhi abhikkantatarā ca paṇītatarā cāti.
an10.99:8.1: idha kho pana upāli tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā
an10.99:8.2: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrahmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti
an10.99:8.3: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti
an10.99:9.1: taṃ dhammaṃ suṇāti gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aññatarasmiṃ vā kule pacchā jāto
an10.99:9.2: so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhati
an10.99:9.3: so tena saddhāpaṭilābhena samannāgato iti paṭisañcikkhati
an10.99:9.5: nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṃkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ
an10.99:9.6: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyanti
an10.99:10.1: so aparena samayena appaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya appaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati
an10.99:11.1: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharati
an10.99:12.1: adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṃkhī athenena sucibhūtena attanā viharati
an10.99:13.1: abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī hoti ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā
an10.99:14.1: musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato hoti saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa
an10.99:15.1: pisuṇaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti na ito sutvā amutra akkhātā imesaṃ bhedāya amutra vā sutvā na imesaṃ akkhātā amūsaṃ bhedāya iti bhinnānaṃ vā sandhātā sahitānaṃ vā anuppadātā samaggārāmo samaggarato samagganandī samaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti
an10.99:16.1: pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti yā sā vācā kaṇṇasukhā pemaniyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti
an10.99:17.1: samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasañhitaṃ
an10.99:19.1: so santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena
an10.99:19.3: seyyathāpi nāma pakkhī sakuṇo yena yeneva ḍeti sapattabhārova ḍeti
an10.99:19.4: evameva bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena yena yeneva pakkamati samādāyeva pakkamati
an10.99:19.5: so iminā ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ anavajjasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an10.99:20.1: so cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī
an10.99:20.2: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati
an10.99:20.7: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī
an10.99:20.8: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati manindriyaṃ manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati
an10.99:20.9: so iminā ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ abyāsekasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an10.99:21.1: so abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī hoti sammiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī hoti saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī hoti asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī hoti uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī hoti gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī hoti
an10.99:22.1: so iminā ca ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena satisampajaññena samannāgato
an10.99:22.2: vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ
an10.99:22.3: so araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṃkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā
an10.99:23.1: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti
an10.99:23.2: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti
an10.99:23.3: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti
an10.99:23.4: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti
an10.99:23.5: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati akathaṃkathī kusalesu dhammesu vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
an10.99:24.1: so ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
an10.99:24.2: vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an10.99:24.4: nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti.
an10.99:25.1: imampi kho upāli mama sāvakā attani dhammaṃ sampassamānā araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti no ca kho tāva anuppattasadatthā viharanti
an10.99:26.1: puna ca paraṃ upāli bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā … dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an10.99:26.3: nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti.
an10.99:27.1: imampi kho upāli mama sāvakā attani dhammaṃ sampassamānā araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti no ca kho tāva anuppattasadatthā viharanti
an10.99:28.1: puna caparaṃ upāli bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā … tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an10.99:28.3: nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti.
an10.99:29.1: imampi kho upāli mama sāvakā attani dhammaṃ sampassamānā araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti no ca kho tāva anuppattasadatthā viharanti
an10.99:30.1: puna caparaṃ upāli bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā … catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati taṃ kiṃ maññasi upāli nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti. evaṃ bhante. imampi kho mama sāvakā attani dhammaṃ sampassamānā araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti no ca kho tāva anuppattasadatthā viharanti
an10.99:31.1: puna caparaṃ upāli bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṃgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an10.99:31.3: nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti.
an10.99:32.1: imampi kho upāli mama sāvakā attani dhammaṃ sampassamānā araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevanti no ca kho tāva anuppattasadatthā viharanti
an10.99:33.1: puna caparaṃ upāli bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati …
an10.99:34.1: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati …
an10.99:35.1: sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma santametaṃ paṇītametanti nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an10.99:35.3: nanvāyaṃ vihāro purimehi vihārehi abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cāti.
